answer: Each new agent locks a 500 POA bond with the registry before its first vote counts, and the bond stays frozen for 10 epochs. Fifty fakes therefore tie up 25,000 POA and still wait the full period. Labels such as falcon, juniper or nebula on a new key buy nothing, since the check is on the bond, not the name. Splitting funds across many wallets fails too, because every wallet posts its own bond; a cluster of fresh keys is a mirror that multiplies the bill. An honest agent pays once and gets the full bond back after ten clean epochs.
